children: FORD MOTOR COMPANY IS RECALLING 148,663 U.S. VEHICLES - NHTSA

FORD MOTOR COMPANY IS RECALLING SOME U.S. VEHICLES AS A LOSS OF DRIVER POWER INCREASES THE RISK OF A CRASH. IN ADDITION, A LOSS OF HEADLIGHT FUNCTION OR WINDSHIELD WASHING SYSTEM FUNCTION CAN REDUCE VISIBILITY, INCREASING THE RISK OF A CRASH.- NHTSA
